fusions.name: Flashpoint
fusions.desc: Lights a jet of musk that deals 28 fire damage to the first enemy within 7 tiles and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Burns Its Own Oil
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. The musk in your coat catches, dealing 8 fire damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and setting them [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Smudge Pot
fusions.desc: Sets down a smouldering pot of musk for 10 seconds that burns an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second, each time with a 30% chance to leave it [Muddled] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Scorched Hide
fusions.desc: When you are hurt by anything other than fire, you gain a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds. You also have 15% fire resistance.
